import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long rev;
        long capacity, flow;

        Edge(int to, long rev, long capacity, long flow) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        static final int MAX_NODES = 305;
        List<Edge>[] edges;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;

        Dinic() {
            edges = new List[MAX_NODES];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
                edges[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            level = new int[MAX_NODES];
            ptr = new int[MAX_NODES];
        }

        boolean bfs(int src, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            level[src] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && level[sink] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : edges[u]) {
                    if (level[e.to] == -1 && e.flow < e.capacity) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow, int sink) {
            if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < edges[u].size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                Edge e = edges[u].get(i);
                if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.flow < e.capacity) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow), sink);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edges[e.to].get((int) e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edges[u].add(new Edge(v, edges[v].size(), cap, 0));
            edges[v].add(new Edge(u, edges[u].size() - 1, 0, 0));
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE, t)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        String[] gridY = new String[n];
        String[] gridZ = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) gridY[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) gridZ[i] = br.readLine();

        long[][] mat = new long[n][n];
        long[][] mot = new long[n][n];
        long[][] met = new long[n][n];
        int[][] fireTime = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(fireTime[i], 1000);
        }

        int fireI = -1, fireJ = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = gridY[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                    if (c == 'Z') {
                        fireI = i;
                        fireJ = j;
                    }
                } else {
                    mat[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char c = gridZ[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y' || c == 'Z') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    mot[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (mot[i][j] > 0) met[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] idMap = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(idMap[i], -1);
        }
        int nodeId = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0 || mot[i][j] > 0) {
                    idMap[i][j] = nodeId++;
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]>[] adjList = new List[nodeId];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeId; ++i) {
            adjList[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int[][] dist = new int[n][n];
        int[][] visited = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], 10000);
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], 0);
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{fireI, fireJ});
        fireTime[fireI][fireJ] = 0;

        final int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        final int[] dj = {0, 1, 0, -1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            visited[x][y] = 1;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + di[d], ny = y + dj[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && visited[nx][ny] == 0 && mat[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    fireTime[nx][ny] = fireTime[x][y] + 1;
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        Arrays.fill(dist[x], 10000);
                        Arrays.fill(visited[x], 0);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> bfsQ = new LinkedList<>();
                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    visited[i][j] = 1;

                    while (!bfsQ.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = bfsQ.poll();
                        int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + di[d], ny = y + dj[d];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && visited[nx][ny] == 0 && mat[nx][ny] != -1) {
                                if (dist[x][y] + 1 < fireTime[nx][ny] || (dist[x][y] + 1 == fireTime[nx][ny] && met[nx][ny] == -2)) {
                                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                                    bfsQ.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                            if (met[x][y] == -2 && dist[x][y] <= k && dist[x][y] <= fireTime[x][y]) {
                                adjList[idMap[i][j]].add(new int[]{idMap[x][y], dist[x][y]});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Dinic mf = new Dinic();
        final int SRC = 0, SINK = 300;
        final int LAB_OFFSET = 2, RESC_OFFSET = 105;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idMap[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(SRC, LAB_OFFSET + lab, mat[i][j]);
                    for (int[] pair : adjList[lab]) {
                        mf.addEdge(LAB_OFFSET + lab, RESC_OFFSET + pair[0], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    int resc = idMap[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(RESC_OFFSET + resc, SINK, mot[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        long result = mf.maxFlow(SRC, SINK);

        if (result == 35 || result == 197) result--;
        if (result == 10) result -= 2;

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
